title: Best productivity app
body: Best planner I have tried so far! You can tell the people developing this app really thought this through in detail and how it can help people struggling with adhd or productivity. So costumizable and many features that others don’t offer.
author: Carolinw5

title: Has some potential but app not really updated
body: The concepts of this todo app has a huge potential as it’s very customisable. Sadly the app isn’t updated very often and is not so straightforward and easy to use as you would hope for a productivity app.
author: Marcel73747

title: Amazing along with desktop app
body: Best productivity application Ive seen if used alongside desktop or web application.
author: herpie44
